caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with ornate detailing and a combination of straight and curved lines. The cabinet has a central section with a glass-fronted door, revealing two shelves inside. On each side of the central section, there are curved glass-fronted compartments with visible shelving within. The wood is depicted in dark brown tones with lighter yellowish highlights and decorative patterns, especially on the vertical panels and the upper section. The top of the cabinet includes an elaborately carved crest with three decorative finials and intricate scrollwork, as well as a rectangular panel featuring a lighter wood grain pattern. The top surface of the cabinet appears to be made of a gray marble or stone material, bordered by a lighter wood trim. There are brass or gold-colored handles and keyholes on the doors. In the top left corner of the drawing, there is a scale diagram showing the cabinet’s cross-section with measurements (5'1" in height and 3'4" in width). The entire composition is set within a roughly square border on cream-colored paper, with handwriting at the bottom right indicating a date and the name of the drafter.
title: China Closet
